summary: The Belgic Confession, which the Reformed Church in America holds as one of its standards, has articles on where Scripture gets its authority, on the difference between the canonical and the apocryphal books, and on the sufficiency of Holy Scripture to be the only rule of faith. Only the article titles were read, so this entry records the churches' position as the titles state it.

points.question: What is Scripture's authority?
points.answer: The title of Article 7 says Holy Scripture is sufficient to be the only rule of faith.

points.question: Which books?
points.answer: Article 6 distinguishes the canonical from the apocryphal books.
